name: A Tower Grove garden

place_source.title: Wikidata: Tower Grove South, a neighbourhood of St. Louis (Q14704506), coordinate location (P625)

blurb: A back garden behind a brick rowhouse in Tower Grove South, St. Louis: a lawn and shrub border under a redbud and honey locust, holly and redcedar along the fence and one large white oak at the back, raided by squirrels and opossums and quacked at by grackles from the fence line.
